Package com.apexfintechsolutions.ascendsdk.models.components

Class OpenLot

java.lang.Object
com.apexfintechsolutions.ascendsdk.models.components.OpenLot
public class OpenLot extends Object
OpenLot

OpenLot represents a cost basis open lot, fully adjusted for corporate actions, return of capital, wash sales, option premium, and so on.

      public org.openapitools.jackson.nullable.JsonNullable<OpenLotWashSaleAdjustmentAmount> washSaleAdjustmentAmount()
